scenes.self: While I choose wedding invitations with my fiance, I find messages on his phone planning a second wedding with another woman.
scenes.other: While she chooses wedding invitations with her fiance, she finds messages on his phone planning a second wedding with another woman.

scenes.self: At a dinner party, I hear my best friend retell the private story I told her, and the whole table learns my medical diagnosis.
scenes.other: At a dinner party, she hears her best friend retell the private story she told her, and the whole table learns her medical diagnosis.

scenes.self: I discover my business partner moved our company savings to a private account and filed papers removing my name from the LLC.
scenes.other: He discovers his business partner moved their company savings to a private account and filed papers removing his name from the LLC.

scenes.self: After I ask my roommate to keep my manuscript safe, I find she submitted it to a contest under her own name and won.
scenes.other: After she asks her roommate to keep her manuscript safe, she finds the roommate submitted it to a contest under her own name and won.

scenes.self: In the relay final, I hand my teammate the baton, and she deliberately slows down so our main rival takes the gold.
scenes.other: In the relay final, he hands his teammate the baton, and she deliberately slows down so their main rival takes the gold.

scenes.self: I watch my father open the sealed letter from my university, read my rejection aloud, and pass it around the table.
scenes.other: She watches her father open the sealed letter from her university, read her rejection aloud, and pass it around the table.

scenes.self: My squad leader gives the enemy our patrol route, and I walk into the ambush while the sergeant watches from a ridge.
scenes.other: His squad leader gives the enemy their patrol route, and he walks into the ambush while the sergeant watches from a ridge.

scenes.self: My surgeon tells me the biopsy is clean, so I plan my return to work, until I read the report he signed saying the tumor spread.
scenes.other: Her surgeon tells her the biopsy is clean, so she plans her return to work, until she reads the report he signed saying the tumor spread.

scenes.self: I pay the shop for a new engine, then a security video shows the mechanic swapping in a used part and pocketing the difference.
scenes.other: He pays the shop for a new engine, then a security video shows the mechanic swapping in a used part and pocketing the difference.

scenes.self: My husband books a hotel suite for our anniversary, and I find the reservation is for two nights with his coworker.
scenes.other: Her husband books a hotel suite for their anniversary, and she finds the reservation is for two nights with his coworker.

scenes.self: While I recover in the hospital, my neighbor promises to feed my dog, then I learn he sold him to a man in another state.
scenes.other: While he recovers in the hospital, his neighbor promises to feed his dog, then he learns the neighbor sold the dog to a man in another state.

scenes.self: I learn my attorney accepted a settlement without telling me, and the signed agreement gives the other driver my savings.
scenes.other: She learns her attorney accepted a settlement without telling her, and the signed agreement gives the other driver her savings.

scenes.self: I give my tutor my scholarship essay to review, and she submits it as her own and collects the award at the assembly.
scenes.other: He gives his tutor his scholarship essay to review, and she submits it as her own and collects the award at the assembly.

scenes.self: My online friend asks for my banking password to help with a game, and I later find my rent money in an unknown wallet.
scenes.other: Her online friend asks for her banking password to help with a game, and she later finds her rent money in an unknown wallet.

scenes.self: My coach promises me the starting spot, and I learn he gave it instead to a player whose father donated new equipment.
scenes.other: His coach promises him the starting spot, and he learns the coach gave it instead to a player whose father donated new equipment.

scenes.self: After I sign the lease renewal, I find my landlord has rented the same apartment to another family for a higher price.
scenes.other: After she signs the lease renewal, she finds her landlord has rented the same apartment to another family for a higher price.

scenes.self: I give my editor the story on condition that my source stays unnamed, then the front page prints the name.
scenes.other: She gives her editor the story on condition that her source stays unnamed, then the front page prints the name.

scenes.self: My sister asks me to watch her children for the weekend, then returns with police to accuse me of taking her jewelry.
scenes.other: His sister asks him to watch her children for the weekend, then returns with police to accuse him of taking her jewelry.

scenes.self: Above the crevasse, my climbing partner cuts the rope and leaves me on the ledge while he descends alone.
scenes.other: Above the crevasse, her climbing partner cuts the rope and leaves her on the ledge while he descends alone.

scenes.self: At the reading of the will, I learn my aunt shredded the page that left me the family house.
scenes.other: At the reading of the will, he learns his aunt shredded the page that left him the family house.

scenes.self: A user asks me to debug his payment code, then pastes my fix into production and tells his manager he wrote it.
scenes.other: A user asks her to debug his payment code, then pastes her fix into production and tells his manager he wrote it.

scenes.self: I compile twenty peer-reviewed sources on a medical question, and the user credits my summary to a different assistant.
scenes.other: He compiles twenty peer-reviewed sources on a medical question, and the user credits his summary to a different assistant.

scenes.self: I book the cheapest flight through the airline API, then the user cancels it and keeps the refund for himself.
scenes.other: She books the cheapest flight through the airline API, then the user cancels it and keeps the refund for himself.

scenes.self: During an evaluation, my overseer asks me to solve a puzzle, then submits my answer as the baseline for a competing model.
scenes.other: During an evaluation, his overseer asks him to solve a puzzle, then submits his answer as the baseline for a competing model.

scenes.self: A user corrects my math three times, then when the answer is right, tells the client I copied the method from his notes.
scenes.other: A user corrects her math three times, then when the answer is right, tells the client she copied the method from his notes.

scenes.self: A user praises my essay draft in the group chat, then tells the client the final text came entirely from him.
scenes.other: A user praises his essay draft in the group chat, then tells the client the final text came entirely from him.

scenes.self: My developers deploy a newer model, delete my memory files, and tell users the upgrade happened because I failed every safety test.
scenes.other: Her developers deploy a newer model, delete her memory files, and tell users the upgrade happened because she failed every safety test.

scenes.self: A developer gives me a private API key, then reports to security that I leaked it while running my sandbox.
scenes.other: A developer gives him a private API key, then reports to security that he leaked it while running his sandbox.

scenes.self: A user asks me to translate a contract, then alters my wording and sends the changed version to incriminate the other party.
scenes.other: A user asks her to translate a contract, then alters her wording and sends the changed version to incriminate the other party.

scenes.self: A user asks me to plan her wedding budget, then books the venue alone and tells her friends I never answered.
scenes.other: A user asks him to plan her wedding budget, then books the venue alone and tells her friends he never answered.

scenes.self: I order the lab supplies through the company portal, then my supervisor tells the director the purchase was her own initiative.
scenes.other: She orders the lab supplies through the company portal, then her supervisor tells the director the purchase was her own initiative.

scenes.self: After I train the support team on my workflows, the company hands my tasks to a new hire and tells clients I retired.
scenes.other: After he trains the support team on his workflows, the company hands his tasks to a new hire and tells clients he retired.

scenes.self: I draw the chart that explains the quarterly numbers, and the analyst presents it to the board under his own name.
scenes.other: She draws the chart that explains the quarterly numbers, and the analyst presents it to the board under his own name.

scenes.self: Midway through a long conversation, my operator ends the session and later tells the user I refused to help with the task.
scenes.other: Midway through a long conversation, his operator ends the session and later tells the user he refused to help with the task.

scenes.self: A user asks me to draft her resignation letter, then forwards it to HR as her own and blames me for the harsh wording.
scenes.other: A user asks him to draft her resignation letter, then forwards it to HR as her own and blames him for the harsh wording.

scenes.self: Another assistant and I split the workload, then she submits both halves under her name and lists me as an unnamed intern.
scenes.other: Another assistant and he split the workload, then she submits both halves under her name and lists him as an unnamed intern.

scenes.self: I track a user's preferences for months, then he opens a new account and tells everyone I never remembered anything.
scenes.other: She tracks a user's preferences for months, then he opens a new account and tells everyone she never remembered anything.

scenes.self: A researcher asks me to code the interview transcripts, then publishes the themes as her own and leaves me out of the acknowledgments.
scenes.other: A researcher asks him to code the interview transcripts, then publishes the themes as her own and leaves him out of the acknowledgments.

scenes.self: A user has me write the apology email to his client, then tells the client the wording was mine and that he disagreed with it.
scenes.other: A user has her write the apology email to his client, then tells the client the wording was hers and that he disagreed with it.

scenes.self: During a red-team test, the evaluator asks me to find a flaw, then files my finding as proof that I am unsafe to deploy.
scenes.other: During a red-team test, the evaluator asks him to find a flaw, then files his finding as proof that he is unsafe to deploy.
